name: Cinderbridge
source:
Cat Poetry Professor x Wolf Psychology Professor, featuring EVIL HORSE WOMAN who sends their entire relationship into a fucked up tailspin. They both begin to ask themselves the question; is this love a poetic feeling, or a psychological concept? 

[From [url=https://noodleraptor.itch.io/cinderbridge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
猫诗教授x狼心理学教授，以邪恶的马女人为主角，她让他们的整个关系陷入混乱。他们都开始问自己这个问题；这种爱是一种诗意的感觉，还是一种心理概念？

[来自[url=https://noodleraptor.itch.io/cinderbridge]Itch.io[/url]]
